pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: src/athena/core/catalog.py:1 Centralizing tool gating decisions in an I/O-free catalog enforces policy invariants without coupling to execution harnesses or host environments.

techniques.evidence: src/athena/core/catalog.py:443 The catalog presents a deep module interface where callers invoke classify(name) or validate(name, params, ctx) without knowing the underlying tier allowlists or policy validators.
src/athena/core/prompt.py:83 CatalogPort defines an explicit structural protocol seam decoupling prompt composition from the concrete catalog implementation.
src/athena/core/prompt.py:468 Prompt composer operates as a pure I/O-free transformation over state structures and historical frames.
src/athena/core/catalog.py:3 The core catalog policy logic is purely synchronous and sequential, keeping all async flow control at the outer harness/lane boundary.
src/athena/core/validators.py:179 Composite validator chains checks sequentially in a simple, readable loop that halts at the first invalid condition rather than nested declarative rules.
src/athena/core/ledger.py:350 Dynamic SQL string formatting in rollup query is explicitly bounded to a fixed allowlist and commented to mark why it is safe.
src/athena/core/approvals.py:512 The approval table replay path exposes a narrow approval lookup rather than a generic map accessor, preventing callers from depending on broader storage internals.
src/athena/core/catalog.py:1 All tool allowlists and categorization rules are colocated in catalog.py, providing high leverage where any policy modification touches a single file.

pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: src/athena/lane/ports.py:1 The browser lane enforces strict protocol seams and edge-only concurrency to isolate turn orchestration from host execution and policy decisions.

techniques.evidence: src/athena/lane/ports.py:1 Packages communicate strictly via structural Protocol interfaces in ports.py rather than concrete class imports.
src/athena/lane/browser_lane.py:98 Browser lane refuses to hold executors for host tools, strictly preventing borrowed surface coupling across the host boundary.
src/athena/lane/browser_lane.py:209 Asynchronous streaming generator run() sits directly at the lane edge, coordinating events while frame composition remains synchronous.
src/athena/lane/browser_lane.py:265 answer_decision provides a simple, deep interface that handles card resolution, replay, and conversation-scoped episode writing behind one call.
src/athena/lane/turn_frame.py:50 SurfaceTurn acts as an immutable carrier of all per-turn inputs (messages, host state, tool results), decoupling turn execution from ambient session state.
src/athena/lane/browser_lane.py:233 Turn execution proceeds in an explicit sequential pipeline: record results, compose frame, run harness, remember frame, append assistant response.
src/athena/lane/browser_lane.py:27 Boundary separation ensures the lane contains zero policy logic, delegating all classification and gating to core modules.
src/athena/lane/turn_frame.py:67 Normalizing and capping incoming surface tool results is implemented as a pure transformation function independent of I/O.
